observations.statement: Ordinary rational Gram factors are not a complete certificate language for rational PSD matrices because square roots of rational pivots need not be rational; rational LDL certificates avoid this issue.
Exact primal-dual equality plus exact rational PSD certificates is sufficient to verify the optimum of the fixed Lovasz-theta SDP without numerical tolerance.
For UNSAT certification, a rational dual theta upper bound strictly below the clause target is sufficient; an exact primal optimum is unnecessary.
A collision verifier must reject a pair with opposite SAT labels when the exact theta values differ; absence of an accepted positive fixture is recorded rather than replaced by a synthetic witness.
Disjoint variable renaming makes the clause-literal conflict graph of a conjunction a graph disjoint union and makes alpha additive; theta additivity remains a separately audited theorem obligation.
Exact certificate verification and existence of polynomial-size exact certificates are distinct questions; H097 isolates the latter under explicit conditioning margins.
C011 expands the inversion laboratory to 46x46 while retaining forty inherited hypotheses and adding six exact-certificate descendants.
C011 records no terminal result: inherited theta routes were narrowed and re-attacked, but no exact statement received a decisive proof or counterexample.
